71 

Timur comes toward me in his impeccable			suit, studying me calmly. Barely taller than Joyce, he moves in that civilian attire			as if he were in uniform. 

'I can't thank you enough,			Princess, for having accepted my invitation.' 

'But you speak			Italian …' 

'My father was Italian, Princess,			and I am very fond of our country.' 

It's up to him to speak, and I			have no intention of losing the advantage. Not a trace of uncertainty or expectancy			disturbs the composed elegance of those hands and face during the long silence I			impose. The same consistent curve, from the strong chin to the high forehead,			separates the unnaturally pale face from the closely cropped black hair. I			hadn't been mistaken: even bald, Joyce would have been quite beautiful. The			cheeks are marked by scars: rather than random wounds, they seem like precise			engravings, carved by the hand of a surgeon-sculptor. Though I am familiar with the			ritual known as the Mensur , 90 it's the first time I've			seen those marks up close and I start counting them: one, two, three … As			I count I meet Joyce's gaze, the same dark intensity. 

'The manager of this hotel was			brilliant and daring to break through the sacred walls of the convent and put in			these large windows. And his daring was rewarded. This view is unparalleled!			I've noticed that even the most boisterous guests fall silent upon entering this room. The hallowed			past of the centuries-old walls captures them and they are absorbed in this silence;			hypnotized, I would say, by the rugged, enchanting backdrop that plunges steeply to			infinity – look down there – and then rises again to Etna's slopes. zh:
71

帖木儿穿着无可挑剔的西装向我走来，平静地审视着我。他几乎不比乔伊斯高，身着便装，行动却如在穿制服。

「公主，实在感激不尽您接受了我的邀请。」

「可你会说意大利语……」

「我父亲是意大利人，公主，而且我深爱我们的祖国。」

现在轮到他说话了，而我不打算失去优势。在我施加的漫长沉默中，那双手和那张脸上没有一丝不确定或期待，搅扰那份沉静的优雅。从坚毅的下巴到高阔的前额，同样连贯的曲线将那张白得近乎不自然的面庞与紧贴的黑色短发分开。我没有看错：即便秃头，乔伊斯也会相当美丽。面颊上布满疤痕：不像是随意的伤口，倒像精确的镌刻，由一位外科医生兼雕塑家之手雕凿而成。虽然我对那名为「决斗剑痕」的仪式有所了解，但这还是我第一次近距离看到这些印记，我开始数：一道、两道、三道……数着数着，我遇上了乔伊斯的目光——同样的深沉炽烈。

「这家酒店的经理大胆而才华横溢，竟打通了修道院神圣的墙壁，嵌入了这些大窗户。他的胆识也得到了回报。这景致无与伦比！我注意到，即便最喧嚣的客人进入这个房间也会安静下来。这几百年墙垣的圣化过往攫住了他们，将他们融入这片寂静之中；我想说，他们被那崎岖迷人、骤然坠入无限——看下面——又再度攀升至埃特纳山坡的背景所催眠了。若你背后没有安稳墙垣之感，这番景观便是一道深渊。是这个词吧？请，过来坐下。你想……
